lighting_signature.practical_lights: low garden path uplights (soft warm tone)

composition.foreground_rule: one dominant subject per hero image
composition.framing: rule of thirds with slight center bias for hero subject
composition.negative_space: reserved for UI overlays or app text

environment_rules.grass: deep emerald, striped, high density, no patchiness
environment_rules.trees: full, mature, dense canopies, no gaps
environment_rules.sky: soft dramatic clouds, slightly enhanced color but realistic

brand_consistency.look: all images must feel like one integrated app ecosystem

hero_subjects.irrigation: sprinkler system / water motion + lawn health
hero_subjects.focus_rule: one clear subject must dominate each image

final_rule: Every generated hero image must look like it belongs to the same premium smart-home / landscaping command center application suite, with identical lighting logic, grading, and composition structure.

prompts.yard: Cinematic luxury hero image for a premium smart home lawn care app. Dominant subject: a confident middle-aged homeowner in a dark LawnCareHive t-shirt kneeling beside a red Toro TimeMaster 21200 30" walk-behind mower, slight smile, one hand resting on the handle. Low to mid eye-level camera angle. Rule of thirds composition, subject center-left. Golden hour lighting — warm directional sunlight from behind/side creating a rim glow on subject and mower. Deep emerald green striped lawn, professionally maintained, high density. Background: dense tall Leyland cypress privacy wall (no gaps, full bottom-to-top taper, ~20ft tall), soft warm landscape uplighting on trees, fire pit with Adirondack chairs. Sky: soft dramatic clouds with golden hour enhancement. Charcoal shadows with detail preserved. Color palette: deep green, warm gold, charcoal shadows, brick red mower accents. Medium-high contrast, natural + enhanced green saturation, soft cinematic highlight rolloff. Bottom section text in elegant serif + modern sans mix, soft warm gold color, subtle glow: Title: 'YARD COMMAND CENTER APP' | Subtitle: 'MOW SMARTER. TRACK EVERY CUT.' | Small icons row: Mow Log · Service · GPS · Hours · Diagnostics. Must feel like one integrated premium smart home app suite identical in lighting, grading, and composition to the other hero images in the series. Photorealistic, no cartoon, no over-HDR, no neon greens. 16:9 landscape format.
